text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian-Egyptian summit in Aswan on Wednesday; King Hussein and Egyptian President Mubarak discuss peace process developments.
- Omani Sultan Qaboos meets Prime Minister Kabariti who delivers a message from King Hussein; discussion covers bilateral ties and the Middle East peace process.
- Sit-in to be staged in protest against the Israeli exhibition from this morning with the participation of unions, political parties and chambers of commerce and industry.
- Jordan's Islamic Action Front party (IAF) signs a memorandum of understanding with Syria's ruling Baath party during a visit by a top IAF delegation to Damascus.
- The government plans steps to improve the conditions of retired army personnel.
- Iraq arrests killers of Jordanian driver.
- Jordan to allow up to 50,000 cartons of olive oil annually as personal gifts by Palestinians to relatives in Jordan.
